name: Com²
description: Com² is a causal-guided benchmark focusing on complex commonsense reasoning in LLMs by incorporating causal event graphs and causal theory to generate structured complex commonsense scenarios, including a challenging subset based on detective stories.
reputation: A niche but interesting causal commonsense benchmark that has seen limited adoption compared with major commonsense datasets.
notes: Uses causal event graphs and intervention to create reasoning scenarios; includes slow thinking guided example synthesis.
